description: The Municipality of Lecce publishes georeferenced bike-sharing stations within its territory. The catalogue supplies a Shapefile and links a map for display. An additional metadata field dates the inventory to December 2014 and specifies the UTM 33N WGS 84 coordinate system. The station locations can define access nodes for active-mobility network and service-capacity planning studies. The source does not list docking capacity, bicycle availability, demand observations or evidence that every station still operates. Later catalogue edits are not treated as later asset observations. Public access is free under Creative Commons Attribution, with no version stated. The native metadata API returned successfully; the browser landing route returned HTTP 429 and remains unverified. Related cycling-route data describe links and planned routes, not these service stations, and the source does not establish a direct network connection or an operational feed.
